134866.overview: A fire breaks out on a luxury passenger liner, forcing the passengers to abandon ship. The player needs to place a lifeboat below them to rescue them. However, only four passengers can fit into the lifeboat, so rescuers must pull it towards the shore on either side to offload the passengers. The player receives a point for every passenger who enters the lifeboat and for every passenger delivered safely to shore. As time passes, the passengers will move faster. If a passenger misses the lifeboat or the player tries to catch one in a full lifeboat, the passenger will fall into the water and get eaten by a shark, and the player will receive a miss. If this happens at the same time a passenger is being unloaded to shore, the player will not receive any points. If the player reaches 300 points without any misses, the points will be worth double until the player does get a miss. If the player has any misses at said score, every miss will be cleared instead. When the player gets three misses, they receive a Game Over. Game A features two lifeboats (one on each side), while Game B features one (which can go to either side).

156500.overview: Hippo Teeth is a pocket LCD game in VTech's Sporty Time & Fun series. The player protects a hippopotamus's teeth by moving a small figure and washing away attacking cavities with a hose. The watch-shaped unit also includes clock and alarm functions.

162009.overview: Here, lions are on the loose, forcing the lion tamers to use chairs to keep the lions in their cage. Each time the player keeps a lion in a cage, they earn two points. As the game progresses, the lions will move faster. If a lion escapes, the player gets a miss. At 200 and 500 points, any misses the player has will be cleared. When the player gets three misses, they receive a Game Over. Game A has two lions, while Game B has three.

208612.overview: Look Alive! Football allows the player to play from a simulated 'first person' view of the game. You are the football player at the bottom of the screen.

219958.overview: Bomb Fight is a portable electronic game released by VTech under the Time & Fun brand in 1982.

462397.overview:
LSI Game Invader tasks the player with defending Earth from waves of alien attackers descending from the upper reaches of the screen. Promoted as a “portable version of authentic Invader,” it condenses the arcade concept into a vertical handheld battle, where the player’s cannon fends off a slow, methodical invasion.

The player controls a ground-based cannon using a three-position slider to move left or right, firing upward with a single red button. Rows of alien ships appear at the top of the VFD screen, inching downward each time the player fires. Destroying all invaders advances the level; missing too many shots allows them to close in. The game ends when the aliens breach the base. The VFD display glows in green and blue hues, with scoring displayed numerically above the playfield.

476302.overview:
The ultimate in hand held Golf! Fighting Golf is endorsed by Lee Trevino and features many challenges! Choose your character (man or woman) and step up to begin 18 holes of the ultimate Golf simulation. Select your club, watch the wind direction; adjust your direction and swing! Be careful not to overswing. Can you Break Par?

Features include Sound On/Off, Best Score Retention, Auto Shut Off and more!

YOU CAN SELECT ONE OF THE TWO CHARACTERS IN THE GAME. SELECT YOUR CLUB, CONTROL THE DIRECTION OF THE BALL WITH THE CURSOR. DON'T OVER SWING!!

SCREEN CONVERTED TO SHOW THE SPOT WHERE THE BALL LANDS.

BE CAREFUL NOT TO LAND IN THE WATER OR GO OUT OF BOUNDS. YOUR SKILL DETERMINES IF YOU CAN LAND THE BALL AT THE RIGHT SPOT.

FINISH THE HOLE BY PUTTING CAREFULLY!

479724.overview: A tribute to the classic Sid and Marty Krofft series, this electronic game brings the thrilling quest for treasure into the palm of your hand.
